cancellation.sec: TERMS panel - NCE membership agreement, General Membership Disclosures, Insurance Disclosures, Limitations and Exclusions
cancellation.v: 30-day free trial: cancel and receive a full refund excluding the one-time enrollment fee, AS LONG AS NO BENEFITS HAVE BEEN USED. After using the program, cancellation terminates benefits at the end of the billing cycle already billed. NCE authorization 'will remain in effect until NCE Association has received written notice from you that it should be cancelled at least 10 DAYS prior to your next bill date.' The FirstEnroll billing authorization in the same document requires written notice 'at least 15 DAYS prior to the next billing date'.

product_type.v: 'NCE Health Choice Silver - Limited Benefit Health Insurance Plans. Limited Benefit Insurance underwritten by: American Financial Security Life Insurance Co.' Document version marker: 'Limited Medical Benefit Cash Policy v1'. 'A Limited Benefit Medical plan is not a comprehensive major medical plan, nor is it intended to replace a major medical plan. The plan is intended to provide you, and your covered dependents, with basic insurance coverage that is CAPPED AT SPECIFIC AMOUNTS FOR SPECIFIC SERVICES.'

excluded_services.v: Policy Limitations & Exclusions, introduced by: 'We will not provide a Benefit for any of the items listed in this section regardless of Medical Necessity or recommendation of a health care provider.' Excluded: care not related to a specific diagnosis, acute symptoms or course of treatment; care that is not Medically Necessary; maintenance therapy not reasonably expected to improve the condition; pre-employment, pre-marital or routine physical examinations; WORK-RELATED INJURY or anything covered by Workers' Compensation or Occupational Disease law; non-prescription drugs, vitamins, minerals and nutritional supplements; experimental or investigational substances, drugs, treatments and organ transplant procedures; care the person is not legally required to pay for; telephone consultations, missed appointments, claim-form completion; care by a Close Relative (spouse, child or parent); health or athletic club enrolment, weight loss, non-smoking or exercise programmes; recreational or educational therapy, non-medical self-care training, nutritional counselling, marriage, family or goal-oriented counselling; care outside the practitioner's licence; education, training, custodial care or bed and board in a school, rest home, home for the aged or personal residence; COSMETIC SURGERY; EYE EXAMINATIONS, EYEGLASSES, CONTACT LENSES, refractive surgery, HEARING EXAMS, HEARING AIDS and their fitting; war, act of war, riot, assault or felony; anything payment for which is prohibited by local law; travel other than professional ground or air ambulance; care before the effective date or after termination; the Friday/Saturday inpatient admission rule; PREGNANCY AND RELATED SERVICES; CUSTODIAL CARE; DENTAL SERVICES; voluntary sterilisation or its reversal; transsexual surgery and related surgery; ROUTINE FOOT CARE; amniocentesis or ultrasound solely for sex determination; infertility and impregnation procedures; intentional self-inflicted illness or injury while sane (not applying where it results from a medical condition); illness or injury during commission of a crime or while imprisoned; PHYSICAL THERAPY, SPEECH THERAPY AND OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY; MENTAL AND NERVOUS DISORDERS; SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS; VENIPUNCTURE; PRESCRIPTION DRUGS; HOSPICE CARE; HOME HEALTH CARE; obesity, extreme obesity, morbid obesity or weight reduction including bariatric and intestinal bypass surgery and complications from it; and illness before the waiting period expires.

pre_existing.sec: TERMS panel - NCE membership agreement, General Membership Disclosures, Insurance Disclosures, Limitations and Exclusions
pre_existing.v: TWO STATEMENTS. Policy language: 'There is no coverage for a pre-existing condition for a continuous period of 12 months following the effective date of a Covered Person's coverage under the Policy.' Disclosure language: 'if you have had care rendered or prescribed to you by a physician within the 12 months leading up to your effective date, you will have a waiting period for 12 months before any claims related to your condition will be covered.'

pregnancy_exclusion.v: 'Pregnancy and related services' is listed as a bare exclusion with NO complications-of-pregnancy carve-out.

waiting_period_other.v: 'There is a 30 day waiting period immediately following the Coverage Effective Date; does not apply to an injury.' Printed as a footnote under the benefit grid. The exclusion list separately excludes 'Treatment, services and supplies for an Illness prior to the expiration of the Waiting Period.'

addons.gapafford_plus.v: GapAfford Plus - NCE Membership Benefits. Disclaimer printed on the same page: 'The benefits described on this page, GapAfford Plus, are NOT INSURANCE and are not affiliated with American Financial Security Life Insurance Co. The GapAfford Plus program does not meet the requirements of the PPACA. YOU MUST PAY FOR SERVICES AT THE TIME THEY ARE RENDERED. If you use a participating dentist, you will receive a discount. NEITHER GAPAFFORD PLUS, AETNA, NBBI, NOR THE DMPO WILL PAY FOR ANY SERVICES RECEIVED. The GapAfford Plus program is not available in Alaska, Connecticut, Delaware, Montana, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont and Washington.' Components: prescription discount card (average 15% brand, 55% generic, national network, no usage limit, no activation, all FDA-approved drugs including lifestyle drugs); Aetna Dental Access Network (over 132,000 locations, 15-50% per visit, cosmetic dentistry and orthodontia included); OUTLOOK Vision Network (over 10,000 locations, 10-50% on eyeglasses frames and lenses, 10-30% on medical eye exams and PRK/LASIK); Pet Rx; Alternative Medicine (average 25% at over 8,000 providers including acupuncture and massage); Chiropractic Care (free initial consultation, up to 50% on diagnostics and x-rays, unlimited treatments at 30% savings, over 12,000 chiropractors); Hearing Savings (20-50% off MSRP); Imaging Savings (average 60% off MRI and CT); Medical Bill Negotiations (no minimum bill); Medical Supplies and Equipment (20-50%); Laboratory Savings via MyMedLab (NOT AVAILABLE IN NY, NJ OR RI); Physical Therapy (average 20% at over 1,200 offices in 23 states); Vitamins and Supplements (up to 75% off retail); 24/7 Health Information Line; 24/7 Nurse Help Line.

exclusions.additional.sec: TERMS panel - NCE membership agreement, General Membership Disclosures, Insurance Disclosures, Limitations and Exclusions
exclusions.additional.v: Sickness or injuries caused by: DENTAL PROCEDURES - dental care or treatment, except for care of sound natural teeth within 12 months of an accident and except where necessary due to congenital disease or anomaly. ELECTIVE PROCEDURES AND COSMETIC SURGERY - except reconstructive surgery incidental to or following surgery resulting from trauma, infection or other disease of the involved part, and reconstructive surgery for congenital disease or anomaly of a covered Dependent Child resulting in a functional defect. FELONY OR ILLEGAL OCCUPATION. MANIPULATIONS OF THE MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM - detection and correction by manual or mechanical means of structural imbalance, distortion or subluxation of or in the vertebral column. SUICIDE, attempted suicide or intentionally self-inflicted injury. WAR OR ACT OF WAR, declared or undeclared; participation in a felony, riot or insurrection; service in the Armed Forces or auxiliary units - but losses from acts of terrorism are NOT excluded unless the covered person who suffered the loss committed the act. WORK-RELATED INJURY OR SICKNESS, whether or not benefits are payable under any Workers' Compensation, employer's liability or occupational disease law. PREGNANCY.

exclusions.general.sec: TERMS panel - NCE membership agreement, General Membership Disclosures, Insurance Disclosures, Limitations and Exclusions
exclusions.general.v: We will not pay benefits for treatment, services or supplies which: are not Medically Necessary; are not prescribed by a Doctor as necessary to treat Sickness or injury; are experimental/investigational in nature, except as required by law; are received without charge or legal obligation to pay; or is provided by an immediate family member.

exclusions.pre_existing_brochure_omissio.v: THE BROCHURE'S POLICY LIMITATIONS & EXCLUSIONS SECTION CONTAINS NO PRE-EXISTING CONDITION EXCLUSION. The only occurrences of 'pre-existing' anywhere in the brochure are two AFFIRMATIVE STATEMENTS attached to the GapAfford Plus discount programme: 'There are no: Deductibles, Pre-existing condition limitations, Medical exams, Claim forms, Limitation on usage, Age restrictions' and, under the Aetna Dental Access Network, 'No pre-existing condition exclusions'.

fees.enrollment_and_billing.v: 'The rates reflect the monthly premium for health benefits as well as the NCE association membership. Rates do not include an association ONE-TIME, NON-REFUNDABLE ENROLLMENT FEE, which is processed at the time of enrollment. Effective dates vary based on enrollment date. The initial premium draft, inclusive of the non-refundable, one-time enrollment fee, is processed the day of enrollment. Future drafts occur once a month, approximately every 30 days.'

fulfillment.v: 'Once a successful payment has been processed with an application, members will instantly receive a Purchase Confirmation E-mail from NCE Member Services. The e-mail includes the NCE Membership Handbook, A SAMPLE CERTIFICATE OF INSURANCE and additional information. Registration and login instructions for your individualized Member Services Portal will be received in a secondary e-mail. PENDING CARRIER APPROVAL OF YOUR APPLICATION, your fulfillment packet will be placed in the mail by the carrier which will include the hard copy of the handbook and PERSONALIZED CERTIFICATE OF INSURANCE within 7-10 business days from enrollment.'

storefront.positioning.v: The FirstEnroll storefront product description for this plan is the two-word phrase 'Over 65'. That is the entire description shown to the agent in the product list. It is identical on all eight Health Choice Silver variants.
